lines.zh: 我穿过林间空地，脚步很轻。
lines.en: I cross the clearing with light steps.

lines.zh: 我的身体前倾，尾巴平伸。
lines.en: My body leans forward, tail held level.

lines.zh: 我踩着落叶，几乎没有声。
lines.en: I step on leaves with almost no sound.
I go around a stand of ferns.
I move between the tree shadows.
Every step, I watch both sides.
I work my way up the slope.

lines.zh: 我的爪子抓住树根，翻过去。
lines.en: My claws catch a root and I climb over.
I stop under a tree and look up.
There is nothing in the branches.
I walk on into the wood.

lines.zh: 受伤的东西，我从不放过。
lines.en: I never pass up something wounded.
I lengthen my stride.
Then I slow again and look first.
I creep through the low ferns.
I know this path well.
I stand with my head slightly tilted.
Only wounded prey is worth the chase.

lines.zh: 有虫，有鸟，还有别的东西。
lines.en: Insects, birds, and something else.
My foreclaws are half drawn in.
Dappled sun falls on my back.
I open my jaws and let the heat out.

lines.zh: 我把尾巴轻轻摆了一下。
lines.en: I sway my tail slightly.
The ferns here are taller than I am.

lines.zh: 我藏在里面，很难被看见。
lines.en: Hidden in them, I am hard to see.
I look up at the canopy. Too high.
A fruit falls. I do not catch it.
That I do not eat.
I lower my head again.

lines.zh: 我前倾着身子，尾巴平平伸着。
lines.en: Body forward, tail held level.
I stop and face you.
My head is low, my eyes turned up.

lines.zh: 你比我高，但你站得不稳。
lines.en: You are taller, but your footing is unsure.

lines.zh: 我看了你的手，也看了你的脚。
lines.en: I look at your hands, and your feet.
Your feet are the weakness.
Half a step from me and you retreat.
That is best.
I do not follow.
Are you injured?
I am scenting you.
I growl and back off.
One of my legs drags a little.
I press myself low.
Blood runs down my flank.
I shake my head about.

lines.zh: 三叠纪的颚，咬下去不松。
lines.en: A Triassic jaw that doesn't let go.
I retreat into the ferns.
They will hide me.

lines.zh: 三条腿站着，另一条抬着。
lines.en: I stand on three legs, the fourth raised.
It is bearable. I can still run.
The smell of meat.

lines.zh: 我朝着你的手走了一步。
lines.en: I take a step toward your hand.

lines.zh: 我停下来，先看你的另一只手。
lines.en: I stop and check your other hand first.

lines.zh: 肉放下，人退开，我才过去。
lines.en: Meat down, you back off, then I come.
I wait a while.
Only then do I go.
I take it and withdraw behind a tree.
A bite, then a glance at you.
This piece is not large.
This meat won't fill the gap in my teeth.
You bump me and I slip sideways.
I give two steps, but do not run.
I turn and hit you shoulder-first.

lines.zh: 我被顶得后退，喉咙里发响。
lines.en: Knocked back, a sound rasps in my throat.
I crouch and watch you.
Come closer again and I will move.

lines.zh: 你撞在我肋上，我纹丝不动。
lines.en: You hit my ribs and I don't budge.
The angle is better here.
You turn; I turn.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴绷直，扫过落叶。
lines.en: My tail goes rigid, sweeping the fallen leaves.

lines.zh: 林子里有另一只的味道。
lines.en: Another's scent is in the wood.
I call once, briefly.
An answer comes back.
She comes out of the ferns.
We stand a few paces apart.
I lower my head first.
She lowers hers too.
We walk into the tree shadow together.
There is a nest near here.
I must guard it.
I take it in my jaws and shake it.
Not meat. I spit it out.

lines.zh: 我叼起猎物，甩了甩脖子。
lines.en: I take the prey in my jaws and shake my neck.
There are insects under it. I eat them.
This is very hard.
I pin it under a foot.
It rolls down the slope.
Let it go.
I raise my head again.
There are other smells in the wood.
Something is behind the ferns.
I press my head down.

lines.zh: 它的动作不稳，是受伤了。
lines.en: Its movement is uneven. It is hurt.
This one I can try.
I circle downwind of it.
The wind brings it to me.
The blood is fresh.

lines.zh: 我盯上了你腿上的旧伤。
lines.en: I've fixed on the old wound on your leg.
Its head is dipping.
It will not last.
I wait for it to dip further.
Then spring.

lines.zh: 我绕过树桩，堵你的退路。
lines.en: I round the stump to cut off your retreat.
My claw prints stay in the wet mud.
I step on leaves without sound.
My tail balances behind me.
It moves toward the tree. Good.
It cannot turn there.

lines.zh: 林间空地上，我步子变大。
lines.en: In the clearing, my stride lengthens.

lines.zh: 它听见我了，护幼的本能先动。
lines.en: It heard me; the instinct to guard young moves first.
It turns its head.
But it is too late.
I am already at its flank.
My hind legs are loaded.
I leap.
I bite into its hind leg.
My foreclaws grip its back.
We roll into the ferns together.
Its blood falls on my chest.

lines.zh: 我的牙咬进你的臂甲缝。
lines.en: My teeth bite into the gap in your arm guard.
It cries out, high and sharp.
I release and bite again.
Its struggles weaken.
I step half a pace off.
Its chest is still moving.
I wait for it to stop.
Then drag it under the tree.

lines.zh: 我从蕨类的缝里站起来。
lines.en: I rise through a gap in the ferns.
The Triassic air is dry.

lines.zh: 这里的树和我记得的不一样。
lines.en: The trees here are not as I remember.

lines.zh: 受伤的猎物，我闻得出来。
lines.en: I can smell a wounded target.

lines.zh: 有猎物，也有更大的东西。
lines.en: Prey here. And larger things.
I must be careful.

lines.zh: 三叠纪的蕨类被我撞开。
lines.en: Triassic ferns part as I push through.
There is a runnel between the roots.
I dip my head and drink twice.
My reflection is in the water.
I lift my head up.
I am not large, but not small either.
Enough to live in this wood.
I step forward.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的尾巴，我猛地转身。
lines.en: Fire catches my tail and I whip around.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滚下去，撞在树根上。
lines.en: I roll down the slope into a root.

lines.zh: 水灌进我的喉咙，我蹬着往上。
lines.en: Water floods my throat; I kick upward.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀翻，我摔进蕨类里。
lines.en: The blast flips me into the ferns.
An arrow in my shoulder makes me walk crooked.

lines.zh: 怪光落下来，我的四肢僵住。
lines.en: Strange light falls and my limbs lock.

lines.zh: 几天没吃到肉，腿开始发抖。
lines.en: Days without meat; my legs tremble.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我整只都被掀开。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and I am thrown aside.

lines.zh: 林子的地面空了，我往下坠。
lines.en: The forest floor gives way and I fall.
